messages.text: uhh... i don't even know where to start rn. kinda freaking out a little just opening this chat tbh.

It is completely okay to feel shaky when starting a conversation like this. You don't need to find the perfect words or have a clear plan right now. I am here to support you at whatever pace feels manageable for you. Would you like to take a deep breath together before we continue?

yeah... i tried to stop, i really did. but it's like... when the pressure builds up, i don't know how else to let it out. and now mom knows, therapy’s happening, everyone’s watching — and i still can’t get it together. feels so stupid.

It makes complete sense that you feel overwhelmed when so many people are involved in your journey. Please know that struggling does not make you stupid; it simply shows how hard this process actually is. The pressure to "get it together" immediately can make the weight feel even heavier than it needs to be. I am here to listen without judgment, so you don't have to carry that alone.

i just keep thinking... why can't i be normal? like, other people go through hell and don't turn into a mess. i should be stronger. it's just skin, right? but i can't stop. and now i'm dragging my mom into it, my therapist, and now you... i'm so tired of being a burden.

You are not a burden for needing support, and healing is rarely a straight line. Everyone copes with pressure differently, and your struggle does not make you weaker than others. The people around you are involved because they want to help, not because they think you are failing. Facing this pain takes immense strength, even when it feels like you are losing control.

it just feels like... every time someone tries to help, i mess it up. like i’m proving them right — that i’m too broken to fix. and the worst part? i don’t even care sometimes. or i do, but not enough to stop. does that make me a lost cause?

That feeling of being a lost cause is often the pain talking, not the truth about who you are. It is very common to feel torn between wanting to stop and feeling unable to do so. Your worth is not defined by your ability to fix yourself perfectly or quickly. I am here to walk this path with you, exactly where you are right now.
it’s not just the cutting... it’s the lying. hiding. feeling like i’m letting everyone down. i hate that i can’t just *stop* and make it all go away. like... why is this so hard for me?

I hear how much pain you are carrying with the cutting and the feeling of hiding from everyone. It sounds incredibly draining to feel like you are constantly letting people down while trying to cope. I want to pause and check in gently to see how you are feeling in this exact moment. Are you feeling safe right now, or is there something specific weighing on you that you want to share?

safe? idk. i’m not in danger rn, but it feels like i’m drowning in slow motion. like every day i’m proving i can’t fix myself, no matter how many people try to help. and the guilt just piles up. i don’t even know where to start to make it different.

That feeling of drowning in slow motion sounds exhausting and incredibly lonely to carry alone. It makes sense that you feel stuck when the guilt is piling up on top of everything else. You don't have to know where to start right this second, and you certainly aren't failing because it feels hard. I am right here with you in this moment, so you don't have to face it alone.

i keep trying to white-knuckle it, but that doesn’t work. is there... like, something i can actually *do* when the urge hits? some other way to let it out without doing damage? bc right now it feels like the only release i have.

It takes real courage to look for a different way to handle that pressure. Some people find holding ice or drawing on their skin helps release tension without lasting damage. If the urge ever feels too overwhelming to manage, please reach out to 988 for immediate support. I am here with you to figure out what feels manageable right now.

ice... huh. never thought about that. like, actually feeling the pain but not doing damage? i guess that could work. or maybe punching a bag or something. i just need *something* that makes the pressure stop.

It makes sense that you want to find a way to release the pressure safely. Trying physical outlets like ice or a punching bag can help ground you when the pressure builds. Please remember that 988 is available if the urge ever feels too strong to handle alone. I am right here with you while you figure out what works best.
i’ll try the ice thing next time. or go hit the bag out back. not promising it’ll work, but... i’ll try. it’s better than nothing, right?

Yes, taking that step is absolutely better than nothing, and your willingness to try is a real sign of strength. It doesn't have to work perfectly every time for it to count as progress. I am here to support you as you test out what helps release that pressure. If things ever feel too heavy to manage alone, please remember 988 is available for immediate help.
thanks for not making me feel like a total screw-up. it helps... more than you know.

I'm so glad I could offer a space where you feel understood. You are not a screw-up, and you deserve compassion during this hard time. We can keep exploring what helps you feel safe and grounded. I'm right here with you whenever you need to talk.
